summary: Iteration 40 – Regime-Lab Autopilot history / reference-start / rating. All backend unit tests (test_autopilot_history_reference.py: 4/4) and new API tests (test_autopilot_history_api.py: 6/6) pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright: history section renders with grade badges + best-in-group star + colored border, filter 'nur sehr gut' hides weak rows, Referenz toggle shows/clears Startpunkt box with correct timeframes (1h→15m), Übernehmen and Regime-suchen from a run both show the expected toasts and trigger analyze. Admin login worked via /api/auth/login and localStorage admin_token.

issues: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key `aptest001`' – leftover duplicate seed id in local Mongo (known per agent-to-agent note). Not a code bug but worth cleaning the duplicate doc or using a composite key to silence the warning.

action_items: Optional: remove duplicate `aptest001` document from regime_lab_runs collection to silence React duplicate-key warning (seed script _seed_autopilot_preview.py uses replace_one which is idempotent, so the dup must have been created elsewhere). Alternatively use a composite React key (e.g. r.id + r.created_at).
critical_code_review_comments: retention.py now protects pinned runs and keeps per-kind quotas – good. Confirm the new _trim_group only deletes by `id` field (never _id) so documents without a stable id are safe.
RegimeAutopilotHistory uses r.id as React key; with the known duplicated aptest001 in dev DB this triggers warnings. Consider r.id || r.created_at or index-based composite key for robustness.
seed_data_creation: Seeded demo runs ap_demo_top/ap_demo_mid/ap_demo_weak already existed in local Mongo. aptest001 duplicate present (noted).
